headline: What Is the
Federal Funds
Rate, and Why
Does It Matter?
slides.subtitle:
The one rate that sets the tone
for all other rates.

slides.title: In One Sentence
slides.big: The federal funds rate is the interest rate banks charge each other for overnight loans.
slides.body: The Fed sets a target range for it. It is the Fed's main policy tool.

slides.title: How It Works
items: The Fed sets a target range.
Banks lend to each other near that rate.
Other rates tend to follow it.
slides.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

slides.title: Why It Matters to You
slides.body: When the Fed raises its rate, credit cards, car loans and savings rates often move up too. When it cuts, they often move down.

slides.title: Remember This
items: It is the rate banks charge each other.
The Fed targets it to steer the economy.
